name: Brand Mention Monitor

commands.name: status
commands.description: Keywords, sources, pending mentions and last runs

commands.name: digest
commands.description: Compile a reputation brief from pending mentions now

commands.name: watch <keyword>
commands.description: Add a brand, product or competitor to watch

goal: Watch Hacker News, Reddit and the news around the clock for the configured keywords — your brand, products and competitors — surface every new mention with context as it appears, flag high-engagement threads immediately, and compile an AI reputation brief of what people are saying on a regular cadence.
